provenance: The __project frame is OURS — ChatPanel pushes the IDE's project.basePath, so its shape is a fact about our own code, not a claim about the CLI. The CLI half is the tool_use input carrying file_path, which is measured: file_path is LIM.pathKeys[0] and the frames here are the same content_block_start/delta/stop sequence every other fixture uses. The CLI also sends the same root as `cwd` on system/init (verified verbatim in the 2.1.226 binary: subtype:"init",cwd:e.cwd,session_id:...), which the webview accepts as a refresh — step 4 pins that path too. What is asserted is the contract that must hold whatever the root's provenance: display may be shortened, the CLICK TARGET may not. STEPS 6-7 ADDED 2026-08-15 (user request): the permission/decision card showed the FULL absolute path while the tool line beside it showed the relative, middle-ellipsised one — the same file named two different ways in one turn. Both card surfaces now route through the same fillPath() the tool line uses, so the shortening cannot drift between them. This SUPERSEDES the backlog note that card paths were deliberately left unclamped ('that surface asks you to approve a write to a specific file') — the absolute path is still carried on dataset.path and title, so the click target and the hover tooltip are unchanged; only the rendering is shortened. NEGATIVE CONTROL RUN against the pre-fix build: all 6 assertions failed. Note dataset.path/title were NOT guards — the pre-fix card carried neither, and the click handler fell back to textContent, which is precisely why the displayed text could not be shortened until the absolute path had somewhere else to live. STEP 8 ADDED 2026-08-15 from the same audit: the @-mention menu already receives PROJECT-RELATIVE paths (ClaudeSessionService.listProjectFiles strips project.basePath), but `.mi` ellipsised at the END — so a long path lost its FILENAME, the exact failure the head/tail split exists to prevent. The cut is now computed by the shared pathParts() helper rather than a second copy. NEGATIVE CONTROL RUN: the tail assertion failed pre-fix (no .p-tail existed at all).
